name: xpro-feed.tweets
purpose_zh: 监听已登录 X Pro 页面的新推文，读取正文、作者、关系、媒体地址及当时返回的互动计数。
purpose_en: Listen for new posts in a signed-in X Pro page, including text, author, relationships, media URLs and engagement counts at capture time.
evidence_zh: 字段依据固定版本的 schema 与解析代码；上游报告真实账号页面验证过 76 条推文（含正文、作者、时间、点赞与浏览量），本工作台未接入真实采集样本。Python 长期运行及 Docker 构建仍未验证。
evidence_en: Fields follow the pinned schema and parser. Upstream reports page-level verification of 76 real posts including text, author, time, likes and views. Studio has no imported collector samples; long-running Python collection and Docker builds remain unverified.

inputs.description_zh: 已登录账号有权访问的列表、用户、搜索或首页列；other 列不采集。
inputs.description_en: Accessible list, user, search or home columns; other columns are not collected.

inputs.description_zh: 只保留指定作者或正文包含关键词的推文，不扩大上游覆盖。
inputs.description_en: Filter returned posts by author or text keywords; does not expand upstream coverage.

inputs.description_zh: 忽略进程启动前发布的推文并关闭主动补抓；运行中新加账号的独立生效时间尚未实现。
inputs.description_en: Skip posts published before process startup and disable active backfill. Per-account admission time is not implemented.

inputs.description_zh: 需要有 X Pro 权限的登录账号；支持 Linux Chromium。登录配置属运行资源，不在卡片保存密码或 cookie。
inputs.description_en: Requires an account with X Pro access; Linux Chromium is supported by the code. Credentials belong in runtime resources, never in this card.

limits.zh: 页面响应缺失的字段保留缺失/null，不能当作 0；字段声明不保证每条推文都返回。
limits.en: Missing response fields stay missing/null, never zero. A declared field is not a coverage guarantee.

limits.zh: 同推文按 ID 与来源列去重；不同列可重复出现。SQLite 按推文 ID 只保存首份，不连续更新互动数。
limits.en: Deduplicates by post ID and column key; posts can appear in multiple columns. SQLite retains the first post record and does not continuously update metrics.

limits.zh: 正文优先长推文文本，但不保证文章、外链全文、完整线程、被引用或转发原文；媒体不含视频文件。
limits.en: Prefers long-post text; does not guarantee articles, external pages, complete threads, quoted/reposted text or video files.

limits.zh: 不提供浏览者、点赞者或转发者名单；浏览量不代表独立读者、读完人数或阅读时长。
limits.en: No viewer, liker or reposter lists. View counts are not unique readers, completed reads or reading time.

limits.zh: 更新节奏由 X Pro 列轮询决定，不是逐条互动事件流；不保证秒级实时或无遗漏。
limits.en: Updates follow X Pro column polling, not individual engagement events; no second-level latency or completeness guarantee.

limits.zh: 本模块只有数据定义，尚未部署。未连接下游；不执行内容价值判断或互动跟踪。
limits.en: This module defines data only and is not deployed. No downstream connections, value filtering or engagement tracking run.

fields.description_zh: 按字符串保存，避免大整数精度丢失。
fields.description_en: Keep as a string to preserve precision.

fields.description_zh: 由作者账号和推文 ID 拼接；账号缺失时链接可能无效。
fields.description_en: Built from handle and post ID; may be invalid if the handle is missing.

fields.description_zh: 优先取长推文 note_tweet 文本，否则取 full_text；只包含响应实际返回的文本。
fields.description_en: Prefer note_tweet text, then full_text; limited to what the response contains.

fields.description_zh: X 返回的语言标记，可缺失。
fields.description_en: Language code returned by X; may be missing.

fields.description_zh: X 原始时间字符串，区别于采集时间。
fields.description_en: Original X timestamp string, distinct from capture time.

fields.description_zh: 推文作者的稳定 ID，不是采集账号。
fields.description_en: Author ID, not the collector account.

fields.description_zh: 作者用户名，可变化或缺失。
fields.description_en: Author handle; can change or be missing.

fields.description_zh: 作者当时的显示名。
fields.description_en: Display name at observation time.

fields.description_zh: 响应中的当时粉丝数，不是粉丝变化历史。
fields.description_en: Count at observation time, not follower history.

fields.description_zh: 读取 is_blue_verified；不是身份真实性或内容可信度判断。
fields.description_en: Reads is_blue_verified, not an identity or content trust assessment.

fields.description_zh: 采集当时返回的浏览/展示计数；原生为字符串，不代表独立读者、读完人数或阅读时长。
fields.description_en: View/impression count as a string at capture time; not unique readers, completions or reading time.

fields.description_zh: 当时的点赞计数；不会持续更新。
fields.description_en: Count at capture time; not continuously updated.

fields.description_zh: 当时的转发计数；不包含转发者名单。
fields.description_en: Count at capture time; no reposter list.

fields.description_zh: 当时的回复计数；不包含完整回复内容。
fields.description_en: Count at capture time; not the full replies.

fields.description_zh: 当时的引用计数；不包含引用者名单。
fields.description_en: Count at capture time; no list of quoting users.

fields.description_zh: media_url_https 数组；不是视频文件、视频播放地址、OCR 或转写内容。
fields.description_en: media_url_https array; not video files, playback URLs, OCR or transcripts.

fields.description_zh: 是否解析出被转发的推文对象。
fields.description_en: Whether a nested reposted tweet was parsed.

fields.description_zh: 只提供关系 ID，不保证原帖全文。
fields.description_en: Relationship ID; original text is not guaranteed.

fields.description_zh: 只提供关系 ID，不保证被引用正文。
fields.description_en: Relationship ID; quoted text is not guaranteed.

fields.description_zh: 回复对象 ID，不保证完整线程。
fields.description_en: Reply target ID; not a complete thread.

fields.description_zh: 程序解析并保存这条推文时的 UTC 时间。
fields.description_en: UTC time when the collector parsed and saved the post.

fields.description_zh: 程序是否主动补抓得到；本需求关闭主动补抓。
fields.description_en: Whether active backfill produced the post; active backfill is disabled for this use.

fields.description_zh: X Pro 内部列 ID；删列重建会变化。
fields.description_en: Internal X Pro column ID; changes when recreated.

fields.description_zh: list:<id> / search:<词> / user:<账号> / home；与推文 ID 共同组成原生去重键。
fields.description_en: list:<id>, search:<query>, user:<handle> or home; paired with post ID for deduplication.

fields.description_zh: list、search、user、home、other；不认识的 other 列不采集。
fields.description_en: list, search, user, home or other; unknown other columns are not collected.

fields.description_zh: 列表 ID、搜索词或用户名等。
fields.description_en: List ID, query, handle or other configured value.

fields.description_zh: 列表名或列显示名。
fields.description_en: List or column display name.

fields.description_zh: 对应的 X Pro 栏目路径。
fields.description_en: X Pro path for the column.

fields.description_zh: 用户列匹配用的账号 ID；解析不到时无法采该列。
fields.description_en: ID used to match a user column; unresolved IDs prevent collection.

fields.description_zh: 当前事件信封版本为 1。
fields.description_en: Event envelope version 1.

fields.description_zh: tweet 是推文；gap、heartbeat、status 是运行事件，不是推文内容。
fields.description_en: tweet is a post; gap, heartbeat and status are operational events.

fields.description_zh: 事件发出时间，区别于发布时间和采集时间。
fields.description_en: Event emission time, separate from publication and capture.

fields.description_zh: 运行元数据；不是作者 ID，不含凭据。
fields.description_en: Operational metadata; not the author ID or a credential.
